data: Epitaph for Publicia Agatha and Publicius Brutanus
A thick rectangular plaque of limestone.
Four centred lines of text, of which the second is much smaller, squeezed between lines 1 and 3; ordinatio not fully planned.
The letters are somewhat crudely cut, with a flat profile channel, and irregular module. The final letters of line 3 are stacked above the line due to lack of space.
Partially reopened following extensive restoration work. Comprehensive collection of archaeological material, predominantly from the West of the island, with an important Etruscan collection.
Centre of Palermo, Piazza Olivella 24, 90100 - Palermo
